# fortiappseccloud_waf_template_caching_compression

Configures caching and compression for one FortiAppSec Cloud WAF template using the static template endpoint `/waf/template/{template_id}/caching_compression`. This resource owns the template's module settings. To make an application inherit them, configure the matching app module resource with `template = true` and omit its `configs` block.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_caching_compression` resource for a WAF template.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_template_caching_compression" "example" {
  template_id = fortiappseccloud_waf_template.example.template_id

  configs {
    status = true

    cache {
      status            = true
      cache_timeout     = 120
      timeout_type      = "minutes"
      allow_method      = "GET,HEAD"
      allow_return_code = "200"
    }

    compress {
      status = true
    }

    cookie_list {
      item {
        name = "session-cookie"
      }
    }

    content_type_list {
      item {
        type = "text/html"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Configuration Notes

- The module, cache, and compression statuses are coupled. When enabling this module, configure `status`, `cache.status`, and `compress.status` together as shown.

## Argument Reference

- `template_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — WAF template ID.
- `configs` (Required) — Typed caching and compression configuration. Its attributes and ownership-wrapper blocks are identical to `fortiappseccloud_waf_caching_compression` when that app resource uses `template = false`.

## Import

Import using the template ID:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_template_caching_compression.example TEMPLATE_ID
```

The first read after import hydrates all supported ownership wrappers.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false`, `configs.status=false`, `configs.cache.status=false`, and `configs.compress.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state. The three statuses are a reviewed coupled disable contract for template caching/compression.
